errors.text_span: 随后在前几层缓慢下降
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization for the 'mean' (blue dashed) line. The line actually rises from layer 0 (approx. 0.72) to layer 1 (approx. 0.74) before it begins to decrease.

The description incorrectly states that the 'max' (red solid) line dips to approximately 0.80 at layer 1. According to the chart, the value at layer 1 is approximately 0.95. The dip to 0.80 occurs at layer 2.
The green 'min' line starts at a gate value of 0.6 at layer 0, as can be seen from its position on the y-axis tick mark. The stated value of 0.55 is an inaccurate approximation.
